title: Understanding Single Linkage
text: Single linkage clustering, also known as the nearest neighbor method, merges clusters based on the shortest distance between any two points in the clusters. Consider how this might affect the clustering of Team Pandas with other teams.

title: Calculating Distances
text: To determine which teams are closest to Team Pandas, calculate the Euclidean distance between Team Pandas and each of the other teams. Remember, the formula for Euclidean distance between two points (x1,y1) and (x2,y2) is $$\sqrt{\left(x2-x1\right)^2+\left(y2-y1\right)^2}$$.

title: Distance from Team Pandas to Team O-Ski
text: What is the Euclidean distance between Team Pandas $$(5,4)$$ and Team O-Ski $$(1,1)$$?

title: Identifying the Closest Team
text: After calculating the distances, identify which team has the smallest distance to Team Pandas. This team will be clustered with Team Pandas in the first iteration of single linkage clustering.
